en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_inspection_ongoing: $names$ is led into the basement playroom for the "basic inspection".
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_inspection_result: $names$ is strapped onto the examination table in the playroom.
en-us.event_erav_sm_inspection_01:
The basement lights hum. The whips, reins and wooden saddles racked by size on every wall stop $party.name$ cold on the stairs.
The old man in the cardigan sits under a lamp doing his woodwork, not looking up.
"You're here. Read this first."
On the whiteboard, in neat handwriting: inspection and development, anal day, bondage endurance, service training... "I bought you for seven days. Every one of these hundred and sixty-eight hours has a subject assigned."
en-us.event_erav_sm_inspection_02:
She is fixed onto a frame like an examination table - wrists and ankles in four-point restraint, hips raised, legs spread and locked into the stirrups.
The old man pulls on rubber gloves, as unhurried as an old country doctor.
"Before a toy is used, it must learn its own specifications. Bear with it. It will feel cold."
en-us.event_erav_sm_inspection_03: Lubricant, speculum, fingers - he measures her inside inch by inch, noting depth, tightness, and the ranking of her sensitive points in his ledger as he goes.
en-us.event_erav_sm_inspection_04:
"Clitoris: sensitive. Vestibule: sensitive. Development: thirty percent." He closes the ledger and reads out her "specifications".
"- No matter. A hundred and sixty-eight hours is enough."
en-us.event_erav_sm_inspection_05:
The examination table folds down into a training rack. "Today's subject: development."
He takes her from behind across the rack, still writing, as if recording observations.
"The reflex contraction is still there - a good sign. A toy with no reaction at all would be boring."
en-us.event_erav_sm_inspection_06:
By the time the inspection ends, it is already dark outside. Her "specifications" are entered on the last page of the ledger, with long blank lines left below.
"Tomorrow: anal day. Be late, and the time comes out of your rest."
